mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, is_read, read_at, created_at) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{msgType}, 1), IFNULL(#{isRead}, 0), #{readAt}, IFNULL(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.content, m.msg_type, m.is_read, m.read_at, m.created_at, m.is_deleted, m.revoked, m.revoked_at FROM chat_message m WHERE ((m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.receiver_id = #{peerId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{peerId} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId})) -- 排除当前用户已删除的消息（发送者删除走 is_deleted 字段；接收者删除走 chat_message_delete 表） AND NOT ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = 1) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_delete d WHERE d.message_id = m.id AND d.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO chat_message_delete (message_id, user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId})
